question: On the joined tree, does routed composition decide more held-out items correctly than the strongest single intelligence available (lineage constituents and admitted exact single genomes), with no added wrong answer?
why_now: On the joined tree (ea90b4b4) greg.cognition.compiler.recipe_stale names a changed recipe closure for all seven recipes: the joined cortex.reason (grant-window guard) and the composition and stage solvers changed under the code converged v1 measured. Live VPL on the joined tree is therefore 0. The founder's rule: bind verification to the actual integrated code; do not transfer old claims; preserve NO_LIFT.

seed_hygiene.assignment: this lane may use 4000-4999 only (another agent uses 5100-5999); reservations 3000-3999 and P8_RESERVED 7000-9199 excluded
checked_against: DEV_SEEDS 0-9 and every lineage's development seeds 0-199
every integer or [a, b] range under a seed-named key in every tracked *freeze*.json, *prereg*.json and *suite*.json (94 files)
every exposure record's seed ranges in docs/evidence/greg-data-exposure-ledger.json (443 records)
seed_hygiene.result: no overlap with spent_seeds(), development seeds, reservations or any freeze or pre-registration. Disclosed numeric overlaps, none with a P6 generator: (1) the ledger records the #158 immune-8 review pilot over seeds 4000-4999 on generator greg.cognition.genomes.collective:immune_gaussian_instance, so every seed in this lane's assigned range shares a number with it (184 of 184 here); 4000-4639 is also used by the develop_repair_hybrid review pilot (repair_instance), so these ranges are taken from 4640-4999 to touch one exposure, not two. (2) seed 4895 (inside F4) appears as a payload seed in cortex/evaluation/suites/crossgeo-heldout-v0.2.json, a cortex crossgeo item with its own generator; no 40-seed contiguous range in 4640-4999 avoids every crossgeo number once F1, F2R and F3 are placed. No P6 generator (composition_lift run.py f1/f2, run_v2.py f2r/f3/f4) has ever been run on any of these seeds.
seed_hygiene.check_command: python seedcheck.py <worktree> (session scratchpad; output reproduced in the evidence README)

arms.constituents: each family's lineage constituent arms, unchanged
arms.exact_single: F3 only: cognition.flow_expansion_mcf (operation expand_capacity_mcf), DEFAULT_FOR_GEOMETRY in admission v3, evaluation-only attach pin in memory. No other family has an admitted single genome answering its whole question; that is stated, not invented.
arms.routed_composition: the cortex router's choice, as in v1/v2
arms.compiled: the same request through the Competency Compiler; reported only

rule: converged rule: routed correct > best single correct (best of lineage constituents and exact_single, chosen on held-out results), routed wrong <= best single wrong, one-sided exact sign test p < 0.05 over discordant items, routed median latency <= 60 s. Lineage rule (constituents only) reported beside it.
reported_not_in_rule: translation and composition failure rates of routed composition
median and p95 latency per arm
the compiled arm's state and stages
which exact single ties routed composition (tied_by)
environment: interpreter, isolation flag, CPU affinity, load average at start and end, and the declared contention
falsifier: Any family where the best single matches or beats routed composition on correct answers, or where routed composition adds a wrong answer, has no converged lift, whatever the lineage verdict was.

development_check.seeds: dev seeds 1-2 of every family (development seeds, already exposed by v1's own check); no held-out seed was generated before the freeze
development_check.found: every arm executed on the joined code; routed and static composition and the compiled arm ANSWERED all 8 items correctly; constituent and exact-single arms behaved as in v1's check. No defect found; no code changed.

execution: once, from a clean detached worktree at the freeze commit, python -I, taskset -c 3 (one core). A full test suite runs concurrently on another core; latency is reported under that contention and is not in the rule except the 60 s median budget.
procedure: Commit runner and pre-registration; in a clean tree run --freeze to write freeze-joined-v1.json; commit it; run once from a clean detached worktree at the freeze commit under python -I pinned to one core; store results, limits and run.log under docs/evidence/greg-composition-lift/2026-10-22-joined/. The run refuses a dirty tree, a missing freeze, any changed input or a non-isolated interpreter. A failed or interrupted run is reported, not repeated on the same seeds.
index_effect: the results file joins P6_RUNS after converged v1; its verdicts bind the recipe code at the freeze commit and decide for the four synthetic recipes, so later code changes make them stale again
authority: none. No attachment, no adoption, no merge.
